nodes.description: Without FOXRED1 the mitochondrially encoded subunits are still translated and are still incorporated into a late-stage assembly intermediate of roughly 815 kDa. That intermediate then fails to mature into the holoenzyme and instead breaks down into a smaller complex of roughly 475 kDa. The same smaller species is detectable in patient cells, so the cellular model and the patient material agree on where the pathway stops.

nodes.description: Biallelic FOXRED1 variants reduce or abolish the function of an FAD-dependent oxidoreductase that acts specifically as a complex I assembly chaperone. The protein has no counterpart role in the other respiratory chain complexes, which is why the biochemical defect is isolated to complex I.

evidence.snippet: This FAD-dependent oxidoreductase, which has never previously been associated with human disease, is now shown to be a complex I-specific molecular chaperone.

nodes.description: With complex I unable to oxidise NADH at normal rates, electron entry into the respiratory chain is restricted. The measured consequences in patient cells are mitochondrial depolarization, raised reactive oxygen species and a disturbed NAD+/NADH ratio. The redox arm matters clinically as well as mechanistically, because it is the step niacin supplementation is aimed at.

nodes.description: Steady-state levels and catalytic activity of complex I fall while the other respiratory chain complexes are spared. Residual activity is partial rather than absent in patient cells carrying the recurrent hypomorphic alleles, and complete absence of assembled complex I on native gels has been reported in at least one more severely affected infant.

nodes.description: Neurons, with high and inflexible ATP demand, are the tissue in which the oxidative-phosphorylation deficit becomes structural damage. The reported imaging correlates span basal ganglia lesions, diffuse cerebral atrophy and polycystic encephalomalacia, and in one infant prenatal-onset periventricular cysts. The range across patients is wide and is recorded as such.
